mechanics.summary: Historical SQL identifies Morchok as entry 55265 and encounter 1292 on map 967. The current checkout has DATA_MORCHOK but no Morchok boss script, loader call, spawn/object mapping, phase, reset, or credit handler.

Stomp is a 1.5-second cast that splits physical damage among eligible targets within 25 yards; the current target and nearest ally take double portions. Heroic sources add a 100% physical-damage-taken effect for 10 seconds.

A crystal appears near a boss and explodes after 12 seconds. Guides disagree whether its three-player/25-player target selection is nearest or random; sources agree that damage scales by distance and the link itself is not damage.
Normal-mode guides report Crush Armor on the current target; heroic guides report it absent. The spell page says 120% normal melee, reduces armor by 10% for 20 seconds, and stacks to 10.
At 20% reported health, Furious increases damage by 20% and attack speed by 30% until cancelled.

Guides describe an Earth pull followed by circular Earth shards used as line-of-sight cover. Sources conflict on the pull damage: the strategy guide reports 1% total health per second for 5 seconds, while the NPC page reports 5% per second for 5 seconds.

Black Blood is a Nature-damage channel; players use shards/pillars for line of sight. The spell page exposes a six-second aura while encounter guides describe a roughly 15-second channel, so the aura duration is not treated as the encounter timer.
At approximately 90% remaining health, guides report a Kohcrom twin with a shared health pool and the same spells a few seconds later. Each side uses one tank and an assigned raid group.

Sources describe alternating Stomp/crystal and Black Blood phases until death or a seven-minute enrage; the exact loop clock, first intermission, post-intermission grace, and enrage implementation are not repository-backed.

The requested cutoff predates Dragon Soul opening. A later official Classic announcement schedules Presence of the Dragon Soul from March 18, increasing by 5% every two weeks to 30%; Lord Devrestrasz can remove the aura. The aura/NPC IDs and default persistence are not published.
